api_report_machinery.report_file_banner: Do not edit this file. It is a report generated by API Extractor.

Those two files must be in the write allowlist, or regenerated via 'yarn build:api-reports' rather than hand-edited. Hand-editing contradicts the file banner; regeneration is the sanctioned path.
ae-undocumented is in the -o omit list, so missing docs do not fail the build today; the run is additive quality work, not a fix for a red build.
--validate-release-tags is on: every documented public export must carry @public / @alpha / @beta / @internal consistently or api-reports errors.
TSDoc @param requires a '-' after the parameter name (STYLE.md:234) or API Extractor warns.
Changeset required: @backstage/catalog-model is non-private under /packages. TSDoc-only changes are adopter-facing docs; check the 39 existing changesets for coverage before adding one.

regulated_repo_note: SECURITY.md is the standard OSS vulnerability-disclosure policy for a CNCF project, not a compliance-obligation marker. No HIPAA/PCI/SOC2/GDPR/PRIVACY/COMPLIANCE files, no regulated/compliance directories, no security-team|compliance-team|privacy-team|legal entries in .github/CODEOWNERS. Treated as non-regulated.

Your .gitignore does not cover .sdlc/. It is currently excluded only by .git/info/exclude ('.sdlc/'), which is machine-local and never committed — so this clone is safe from 'git add -A', but any other clone, teammate, or CI checkout is not. Gate 0 will offer to add .gitignore to this run's allowlist so the exclusion becomes durable and shared.

Husky pre-commit runs 'yarn lint-staged', which on staged *.ts runs 'eslint --fix' + 'prettier --write' and on *.md runs prettier plus scripts/check-docs-quality. Commits made during the run will reformat touched files.

Three overlapping agent instruction files (AGENTS.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md symlinked to it, .cursor/rules/*.mdc mirroring it) carry hard rules: never run yarn build/release, always pass a path to yarn test, no copyright-year bumps on existing files, changesets edited by hand not via CLI.
